title: tasks crates: gaps found writing the local Tasks spec
description: From docs/specs/jmap-tasks-local.md Implementation notes: (7) stale TasksBackend::destroy_object rustdoc says onDestroyRemoveTasks is not done, but the handler does it (bd JMAP-ji1v); (10) when the workflow mirror clears progress, progressUpdated is not set; (16) decision 44: an update of a missing Task that changes a server-set property gets invalidProperties from jmap_server::check_read_only_patch instead of notFound (check whether the precedence agent fixed the shared helper); (19) Task/query sort by id gets unsupportedSort though Calendars -34 makes id sort MUST, and the MemoryBackend supports no sort. Also JMAP-tna1.3.26: add TaskList/Task/TaskNotification Data Types rows (Yes/Yes/No history) to jmap_types::DATA_TYPES, now unblocked by the local spec.
close_reason: Done in 77e8464d: progressUpdated set when the mirror clears progress (local spec rule 1, RFC 8984 §5.2.6); decision 44 confirmed for Task/set with a test; Task/query sorts by id/uid/start/created/updated (calendars-34 §5.11.2; recurrenceId dropped, BREAKING), memory backend sorts. tna1.3.26 and the stale doc were done in 6c17031e.
